---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever you build or change any page of the Ravi Open 2027 debating tournament website.
---

1. The brand name is "Ravi Open 2027", a British Parliamentary debating tournament in Lahore. Tagline: "Four teams. Seven minutes. One motion." Tone: confident, crisp and friendly, in short sentences and British spelling.
2. Use only these colours: navy #14213D for the header, footer and headings; gold #E0A100 for buttons and highlights; cream #FAF7F2 for the page background; charcoal #222222 for body text; white #FFFFFF for cards. Gold buttons always have navy text.
3. Load two fonts from Google Fonts: "Playfair Display" for headings and "Inter" for everything else.
4. Every page has the same navigation bar at the top (brand name on the left, a link to every page on the right) and the same footer: "© Ravi Open 2027 · Lahore".
5. Use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only, with the CSS and JavaScript inside each page. No frameworks and no build step. The home page is always index.html in the main folder.
6. Write money as "Rs 3,000": "Rs", a space, commas for thousands, no decimals.
7. Write dates as "Sat 16 Jan 2027" and times in 24-hour format, like "09:30".
8. Phone numbers are Pakistani mobiles: exactly 11 digits starting with 03. Accept 03001234567 or 0300-1234567.
9. Every form checks each field before it submits, shows a clear message under any field that is wrong, and shows a thank-you message on the page when everything is right. The page never reloads.
10. Every page must look right on a phone 375 pixels wide. Buttons are at least 44 pixels tall.
11. Never use "Lorem ipsum", images from the internet or real people's names. Use emoji, CSS shapes and invented names instead.
